records.groupTitle: Speaker Of Parliament And Chairs Of Permanent Committees By Sex
records.title: Speaker Of Parliament And Chairs Of Permanent Committees By Sex, Annual
records.footnote: Data from year 2012 to 2015 are based on the start of the 12th Parliament term. Data are based on the start of each Parliament term. Data from year 2016 to 2019 are based on the start of the 13th Parliament term. Data from year 2020 are based on the start of the 14th Parliament term. Data from year 2025 are based on the start of the 15th Parliament term. Data are used for SDG 16.7.1 'Proportions of positions in national and local institutions, including (a) the legislatures; (b) the public service; and (c) the judiciary, compared to national distributions, by sex, age, persons with disabilities and population groups'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 16.7.1.
